manifest.algorithm: Find exact JSON raw_decode span start of scenarios object id read-update.singleton.create-bead. Insert json.dumps(parsed scenario.json, indent=2).replace(newline,newline+four spaces) plus comma,newline,four spaces immediately before that start. Preserve every other source byte.

coverage.algorithm: Replace only exact JSON raw_decode span of rows object id read-update.discovery.operation-directory with json.dumps(parsed coverage-row.json,indent=2).replace(newline,newline+four spaces). Preserve every other byte.

limitation: Data-only reconstruction instructions, not execution or formatter output. Verify hashes after restore; committed Git object availability is required.
